obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Choose candidate with fingers aligned along the pen's long axis (yaw close to object_long_axis_yaw)
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1)

grasp(candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_x, target_y = spot["x"], spot["y"]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]  # Align pen with case's long axis

# Calculate required gripper yaw to achieve desired object orientation at drop
# We want the object's long axis to be at target_yaw after placement
# At grasp, object's long axis was at candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
# Gripper yaw at grasp was candidate["yaw"]
# So we need to rotate by: (target_yaw - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]) 
# Then set gripper yaw to: candidate["yaw"] + (target_yaw - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"])
delta_yaw = target_yaw - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18, yaw=candidate["yaw"] + delta_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
